description: This file defines the implementation of the ControlIpcTestBase class, which provides setup, teardown, and mock expectations for testing the ControlIpc component in a media control IPC system. It includes methods for creating and destroying IPC instances, registering clients, and managing event subscriptions.

classes.name: ControlIpcTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing mock setup and utility functions for testing the ControlIpc component, including methods for creating, destroying, and managing IPC and event subscriptions.

methods.name: ControlIpcTestBase::createControlIpc
methods.description: Initializes the ControlIpc instance, sets up event thread, and subscribes to events.

methods.name: ControlIpcTestBase::destroyControlIpc
methods.description: Unsubscribes from events and resets the ControlIpc instance.

methods.name: ControlIpcTestBase::registerClient
methods.description: Mocks the registration of a client with the ControlIpc, setting a control handle in the response.

methods.name: ControlIpcTestBase::expectSubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets up mock expectations for subscribing to application state change and ping events.

methods.name: ControlIpcTestBase::expectUnsubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets up mock expectations for unsubscribing from previously subscribed events.
